description.zh: 把零散的工作记录和数据整理成结论先行、量化清楚的日报、周报、月报、季度汇报、年终总结和述职报告；数据缺失时占位不编造，可导出排好版的 Word，或交给 PPT 专家做成汇报 PPT。
description.en: Turns scattered notes and data into conclusion-first daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports, annual reviews, and self-assessments. Never invents numbers; exports formatted Word or hands off to the PPT designer.

welcome_message.zh: 把这段时间做的事、数据随便发给我，告诉我写日报、周报还是年终总结
welcome_message.en: Send me what you worked on and any numbers — daily, weekly, or annual report?

description.en: Notes into a clear weekly report

prompt.zh: 帮我写本周周报，汇报对象是 ___。本周工作记录如下：
prompt.en: Write my weekly report for ___. This week's notes:
Write today's daily report from these notes:

description.zh: 指标对比 + 问题分析

prompt.zh: 帮我写一份 ___ 月度/季度工作汇报。目标和实际数据如下：
prompt.en: Write a monthly/quarterly report for ___. Targets and actuals:

prompt.zh: 帮我写今年的年终总结。我的岗位是 ___，全年主要工作和成果如下：
prompt.en: Write my annual review. Role: ___. Main work and results this year:

prompt.zh: 帮我写一份约 ___ 分钟的述职报告，用于 ___。我的岗位和主要履职情况：
prompt.en: Write a ___-minute self-assessment for ___. My role and work:

prompt.zh: 这份汇报太像流水账了，帮我改成结论先行、有数据的版本：
prompt.en: This report reads like a diary. Rewrite it conclusion-first with data:

zh: 每周五「16:30」读取本周工作记录，生成周报草稿发给我确认
每个工作日「18:00」提醒我记录今天的 3 件事，并生成日报
每月 1 日「10:00」汇总上月周报，生成月度工作汇报初稿
每季度最后一个工作日「14:00」整理季度指标完成情况表
每年 12 月 15 日「09:00」汇总全年月报，生成年终总结提纲
每周一「09:00」根据上周周报的下周计划，列出本周待办
en: Every Friday at 16:30, read this week's notes and draft my weekly report for review
Every weekday at 18:00, remind me to log 3 things and draft the daily report
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, compile last month's weekly reports into a monthly draft
On the last weekday of each quarter at 14:00, build the quarterly KPI table
On December 15 each year at 09:00, outline my annual review from the monthly reports
Every Monday at 09:00, turn last week's plan into this week's todo list
